I will use the fertilizer I received from FISP on this maize plot because it is my main crop and I need a good harvest to feed my family. I will also plant the hybrid seed that came with the subsidy. I cannot afford to pay for extra workers, so my children and I will do the ridging, weeding, and harvesting ourselves. We depend entirely on the rains here in Dowa, so I will not irrigate, and I do not see the need for chemicals to protect maize.
